title: Generate support-tier matrix from conformance receipts
notes: Implements the MBR-808 generator (tools/productization/generate-support-matrix.mjs), which derives the published support-tier matrix from real MBR-801 installed-path conformance receipts (evidence/qualification/mbr801/<platform>/receipt.json, schema orthic.mbr801-installed-receipt.v1) rather than from prose or a hand-maintained table. The generator delegates all pass/fail conformance logic to the existing, unmodified scripts/qualification/verify-mbr801-evidence.mjs validator (imported, never re-implemented), cross-checked against the current commit and an explicit release generation. The client universe (claude, codex, cursor, generic_mcp, windsurf) is read from the existing MBR-206 artifact docs/clients/support-matrix.v1.json and is never hand-typed or written by this generator. A platform/client pair renders `qualified` only when a current, fully verified receipt for that exact platform names that exact client; every other case (no receipt, stale commit, different release generation, a receipt naming a different client, or an incomplete/malformed receipt) renders `unavailable` — never `unsupported`, never `qualified` without evidence. The SAME generated matrix is written to every surface this task's allowlist covers: docs/support-matrix.md and docs/support-matrix.json (canonical, machine- and human-readable), a marker-delimited generated block in README.md, and server.json's per-target nativeArtifacts[*].platformReceipt fields (the MCP Registry server descriptor) — server.json is left byte-identical when a run produces no semantic change, so it is never gratuitously reformatted. Because no MBR-807/903 release-evidence manifest exists yet in this repository (both are later, undone Wave-3 tasks) and no evidence/qualification/mbr801/** receipt exists yet (MBR-801's harness is deferred to the Book 2 gate per MEMBRANE-BOOK-MODE-EXECUTION-RULES.md), every row in the generated matrix currently, correctly renders `unavailable` with an honest reason string sourced from the real validator. This is the expected, non-fabricated state until real receipts and release evidence land at a later Book gate; re-running the generator once they exist will flip only the rows a real receipt actually proves, with no code change required. tools/productization/generate-support-matrix.mjs and its test replace an earlier, unrelated same-named pair of files (git commit 156c7972, predating MBR-801) that derived a support matrix from a speculative `orthic.membrane.client-qualification.v1` receipt schema with no producer anywhere in the codebase; this task's dependency brief explicitly directs deriving the matrix from MBR-801's real, landed conformance receipts instead, so those files were corrected in place rather than left inconsistent with the actual evidence chain. Deterministic tests in tools/productization/generate-support-matrix.test.mjs build real, valid MBR-801 receipt fixtures by reusing scripts/qualification/run.mjs's own buildReceipt/SCENARIOS (never hand-typing the receipt schema), and prove: no receipts renders every row unavailable; no release generation renders every row unavailable even with a receipt present; a real current receipt qualifies exactly its platform and named client and no sibling client or platform; a stale-commit or incomplete-scenario receipt never qualifies even though the file is otherwise well-formed; render() produces one row per platform/client pair; the README marker splice round-trips and rejects a README missing the markers; and applyServerJson only ever fills a target's platformReceipt when that exact platform is currently qualified, leaving all others null.
